main_issue: Whether and how Agent D can keep cooking strong-smelling devil curry in the shared flat given the smell affecting A's calls, B's room and clothes, and C's laundry.

A-B.evidence: A asked for no strong-smelling cooking (T1), then accepted the Saturday compromise (T5, T7); B objected that the day doesn't matter (T8), then accepted once a week on Saturday with window open (T14, T18). Neither addressed the other directly.

A-C.evidence: A's Saturday proposal (T5, T7); C's laundry complaint (T3, T9), then C accepted the open window (T15). Neither addressed the other directly.

A-D.evidence: D resisted at first (T4), then agreed 'Saturday works for me' (T6) and later opened-window plan; A thanked D (T7).

B-C.evidence: C backs B: 'She's right' (T9); C agrees with B's window fix (T15).

B-D.evidence: B rejected Saturday and notification (T8, T12); D offered once a week (T13); B proposed window plus closed door (T14); D agreed (T16); B thanked D (T18).

C-D.evidence: C said the day doesn't matter for laundry (T9); D offered notice and a weekly cook (T10, T13); C said the window would work (T15); D agreed (T16).
